en: Goods classification guidelines are guidelines for classifying goods of central administrative agencies established under the Constitution or the Government Organization Act or other laws, and are guidelines prescribed by the Article 5 of the Commodity Management Act
und: 물품분류지침(Goods classification guidelines)은 「헌법」 또는 「정부조직법」 그 밖의 법률에 따라 설치된 중앙행정기관의 물품을 분류하는 지침으로 물품관리법 제5조 규정에 따라 물품분류지침에서 정하는 지침이다

en:
Semiconductor HS Standard Interpretation Guidelines are one of the guidelines for item classification for the national strategic industry produced by the Korea Customs Service and are provided by the HS Guide of the Customs Law Information Portal. The HS Guide of the Customs Law Information Portal provides guidelines for HS standard analysis for displays, secondary batteries, and automobiles, including this guideline.


Consisting of two sectors, the first half (standard interpretation guidelines) included item numbers for 258 types of raw materials, parts, and equipment for each semiconductor production process, and photos and detailed explanations for each product, and the second half (technical data collection) explained the latest semiconductor information and trends, semiconductor power generation process, semiconductor production process, and technical terms along with diagrams to help basic understanding of semiconductors, making them widely available not only to industry officials but also to related policy authorities.
und:
반도체 HS 표준해석 지침(Semiconductor HS Standard Interpretation Guidelines)은 관세청에서 제작한 국가 전략산업에 대한 품목분류 지침 중 하나로, 관세법령정보포털의 HS가이드에서 제공하고 있다. 관세법령정보포털의 HS가이드에서는 본 지침을 포함하여 디스플레이, 이차전지, 자동차에 대한 HS 표준해석 지침을 제공한다.


두 부문으로 구성되어 전반부(표준해석 지침)에는 실제 거래 제품 중심으로 반도체 생산공정별 원재료·부품·장비 258종에 대한 품목 번호, 해당 물품별 사진과 상세 설명을 수록하였고, 후반부(기술자료집) 에는 반도체에 대한 기본적인 이해를 돕기 위해 최신 반도체 정보와 동향, 반도체 발전과정과 반도체 생산공정, 전문용어 등을 도표와 함께 설 명하여 업계 관계자는 물론 관련 정책당국도 널리 활용할 수 있도록 제작 하였습니다.

en: The Standards for classification of cost components of cost components of defense cost are classified into material costs, labor costs, expenses, general management costs, and profits.
und: 방산원가대상물자 원가 구성요소의 비목(費目) 분류 기준(Standards for classification of cost components of defense cost-eligible materials)는 방산원가대상물자의 원가계산에 관한 규칙 제2절(제15조~제19조)에서 정한 비목의 분류기준으로, 재료비, 노무비, 경비, 일반관리비, 이윤으로 나뉜다.

prefLabel.en: Standards for classification of cost components of defense cost-eligible materials
prefLabel.ko: 방산원가대상물자 원가 구성요소의 비목 분류 기준

en: This is a list of “Insect” information from the Pest and Disease Information > Pest and Disease Encyclopedia section provided by the National Crop Pest Management System. The list provides basic information about insects, including the Korean species name, species name, full scientific/class name, order/family name, genus name, English alias, year of naming, and naming authority. It also includes general information such as host plants, ecological information, morphological characteristics, and quarantine information, as well as information on natural enemy insects, crop-specific damage information, and insect photographs. The information provided may vary for each insect species.
ko: 국가농작물병해충관리시스템에서 제공하는 병해충 정보>병해충별 도감정보 중에서 ‘곤충’정보에 해당하는 목록이다. 해당 목록에서는 곤충에 대한 기본정보(한글종명, 종명, 전체학명/강명, 목/과명, 속명, 영문별칭, 명명년도/명명자)와 함께 일반정보(가해식물, 생태정보, 형태정보, 검역정보), 대상 천적곤충정보, 작물 별 피해정보, 그리고 곤충 사진정보를 제공한다. 각 곤충마다 제공되는 정보가 다를 수 있다.

prefLabel.en: Disease and Pest Information(by Disease and Pest):Insect

en: The Classification of Health and Medical Service Technology is a classification system for efficiently managing information, manpower, research, and development projects related to health and medical technology and is stipulated in Article 7-2 of the Health and Medical Technology Promotion Act (Preparation of the Health and Medical Technology Classification System). When creating a health and medical technology classification system, it must be prepared in connection with the national science and technology standard classification table, and measures such as improvement shall be taken by reviewing the feasibility every three years.
ko: 보건의료기술 분류체계(Classification of Health and Medical Service Technology)는 보건의료기술 관련 정보ㆍ인력ㆍ연구ㆍ개발 사업을 효율적으로 관리하기 위한 분류체계로 보건의료기술 진흥법 제7조의2(보건의료기술 분류체계 작성)에서 규정하고 있다. 보건의료기술 분류체계 작성시에는 국가과학기술표준분류표와 연계되도록 작성해야 하며 3년주기로 타당성을 검토하여 개선 등의 조치를한다.

prefLabel.en: Classification of Health and Medical Service Technology

en: Industrial Accident Insurance Premium Rates by Business Type and Examinations of Business Types is a classification of industrial accident insurance rates paid by employers for compensation for workers' occupational accidents by industry, and the Minister of Employment and Labor announces the premium rates for 28 business types by December every year. The business type example table stipulates tax items and content examples to apply the premium rates for each industry.
und: 사업종류별 산재보험료율 및 사업종류 예시(Industrial Accident Insurance Premium Rates by Business Type and Examples of Business Types)는 근로자의 업무상 재해 보상을 위해 사업주가 부담하는 산재보험료율을 업종별로 구분한 것으로, 고용노동부장관이 매년 12월까지 28개 사업종류별 보험료율을 고시합니다. 사업종류 예시표는 각 업종에 따른 보험료율 적용을 위해 세목과 내용 예시를 규정합니다.

prefLabel.en: Industrial Accident Insurance Premium Rates by Business Type and Examples of Business Types

en: The Classification of Fields of Service for Social Service Personnel is a classification of areas in which social service personnel should serve as stipulated in Article 47-3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Military Service Act pursuant to Article 26 (3) of the Military Service Act.
ko: 사회복무요원의 복무분야 분류(Classification of Fields of Service for Social Service Personnel)는 병역법 제26조제3항에 의하여 병역법 시행령 제47조의3에서 정하고 있는 사회복무요원이 복무하여야 할 분야의 분류이다.

prefLabel.en: Classification of Fields of Service for Social Service Personnel

en: The Industrial Technology Classification Table (ITC) is a classification system established to efficiently promote the planning, evaluation, and management of industrial technology innovation projects. This classification table is stipulated in the "Industrial Technology Classification Table [Appendix 1] of the Administrative Regulations" pursuant to Article 16 of the "Common Operation Guidelines for Industrial Technology Innovation Projects."
und: 산업기술분류표(Industrial Technology Classification Table)은 산업기술혁신사업의 기획ㆍ평가ㆍ관리에 관한 업무를 효율적으로 추진하기 위해 수립한 분류체계의 분류표이다. 이 분류표는 '산업기술혁신사업 공통 운영요령 제16조'에 의하여 '동 행정규칙 [별표1] 산업기술분류표' 에서 정하고 있다.

prefLabel.en: 산업통상자원부(Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy)

und: Taxonomy of Key Management Document Types or Categorizations

en: "The following represents a linear or flat representation of the different enterprise Discipline related Document types or classifications. Such types are used by IT Professionals and the enterprises they provide services to as a means of identifying, defining, classifying, organizing, storing, and publishing different enterprise documents. This taxonomy is critical to multiple enterprise Disciplines such as Document Management, Artifact Management, and Records Management. Such taxonomies are commonly used in Document Management Systems as a means of tagging Documents as a means of assisting in organization and search."

The Industry Association Table Sector Classification is a classification system used to prepare the Bank of Korea's Input-Output Table (statistics table), which includes product classification and industry classification. The classification can be confirmed as follows. 'Bank of Korea Economic Statistics System > Statistical Search > Statistics Table > 2.2 Input-Output Table > 2.2.n. yyyyy Year Actual Table > 2.2.n.1 File Download' 

Example) 2020 Input-Output Table Division Classification: Bank of Korea Economic Statistics System>Statistics Search>Statistics Table>2.2 Input-Output Table>2.1. 2020 Measurement Table>2.1.1 File Downloads> 2020 Segment Classification Table
und:
산업연관표 부문분류(Industry Association Table Sector Classification)는 한국은행 산업연관표(통계표)를 작성하는데 사용하는 분류체계로, 상품분류와 산업분류가 있다. 해당 분류는 다음에서 확인할 수 있다.  '한국은행 경제통계시스템 > 통계검색 > 통계표 > 2.2 산업연관표 > 2.2.n. yyyy년 실측표 기준 > 2.2.n.1 파일다운로드' 

예시) 2020년 산업연관표 부문분류: 한국은행 경제통계시스템>통계검색>통계표>2.2 산업연관표>2.2.1. 2020년 실측표 기준>2.2.1.1 파일다운로드> 2020 부문분류표

en: The Commercial District Business Type Classification is a classification code provided by the Ministry of SMEs and Startups (MSS) through the Commercial Districts Information System. This system offers free information on commercial districts, competition, location, and profitability to support entrepreneurship and business management. The classification information can be found in the system's notification section in an Excel file, categorized into major, medium, and minor classifications. Searches are made based on the minor classification unit. As a reference, the platform name for the Commercial Districts Information System was changed to Big Data Platform Small Business 365 in November 2024, and in January 2025, the business type classification of the Commercial Districts Information System was also changed to the Big Data Platform Commercial Districts Information Business Type Classification. However, the 247 business type classification codes remain the same.
ko: 상가(상권) 업종분류(Commercial District Business Type Classification)는 중소벤처기업부에서 제공하는 상권정보 시스템의 분류코드로, 상권, 경쟁, 입지, 수익 등을 분석해 창업 및 경영에 필요한 정보를 무료로 제공한다. 해당 분류정보는 시스템 내 알림정보에서 엑셀 파일로 확인 가능하며, 대분류, 중분류, 소분류로 나뉘며 소분류 단위로 검색이 이루어진다. 이 분류코드는 한국표준산업분류 10차의 분류를 기반으로 작성되었으나, 업종분류 정제에 따라 상권업종분류 연계표와 상이할 수 있다. 참고로 2024년 11월에 상권정보시스템 플랫폼 명칭도 빅데이터플랫폼 소상공인365로 변경되었으며, 2025년 1월에는 상권정보시스템 업종분류도 빅데이터플랫폼 **상가(상권)정보 업종분류**로 변경되었다. 단, 247개의 업종분류 코드는 동일하다.

prefLabel.en: 소상공인시장진흥공단(Small Enterprise and Market Service, SEMA)

en:
Service Industry Classification is a classification of industries related to the service industry based on a major classification in the Korean Standard Industrial Classification.

The Korean Standard Industrial Classification (KSIC) consists of the following 16 major categories (E, G, U) based on the major categories

Code : Classification Name 
E: Water, sewage and waste disposal, and raw material regeneration business	
G: Wholesale and retail business	
H: Transportation and warehouse business
I: Accommodation and restaurant business	
J: Information and communication business	
K : Financial and insurance businesses	
L: Real estate business	
Man: Professional, scientific and technical service industries
N: Business facility management, business support, and rental service business
O: Public administration, defense and social security administration
P: Education service industry
Q: Health and social welfare services
R: Arts, sports and leisure services
S: Associations and organizations, repair and other personal services businesses
T : Employment activities in households and self-consumption production activities
U: International and foreign institutions
und:
서비스업분류(Service Industry Classification)는 한국표준산업분류에서 대분류 기준으로 서비스업과 관련한 산업을 분류한 것이다.

한국표준산업분류(KSIC)에서 대분류 기준으로 다음에 해당하는 16개 대분류(E, G ~ U) 부문으로 구성

코드 : 	대분류 명칭
E :	수도, 하수 및 폐기물 처리, 원료재생업	
G :	도매 및 소매업	
H :	운수 및 창고업
I :	숙박 및 음식점업	
J :	정보통신업	
K :	금융 및 보험업	
L :	부동산업	
M :	전문, 과학 및 기술서비스업
N :	사업시설 관리, 사업지원 및 임대서비스업
O :	공공행정, 국방 및 사회보장행정
P :	교육 서비스업
Q :	보건업 및 사회복지 서비스업
R :	예술, 스포츠 및 여가관련 서비스업
S :	협회 및 단체, 수리 및 기타 개인 서비스업
T :	가구 내 고용활동, 자가소비 생산활동
U :	국제 및 외국기관

en: The Election Commission Records Classification Standard Table is prepared and operated in accordance with the records management rules of the permanent records management agency, and includes management items such as job description, retention period, storage place, and disclosure status. Records are created and managed by the records management system, and new records and changes are notified to the information and communication network every year. In the case of administrative information data sets, a separate management standard is prepared and operated.
ko: 선거관리위원회 기록물분류기준표(Election Commission Records Classification Standard Table)는 영구기록물관리기관의 기록물 관리 규칙에 따라 작성·운영되며, 업무설명, 보존기간, 보존장소, 공개여부 등 관리항목을 포함합니다. 기록물은 기록관리시스템에서 생성·관리되며, 신규 기록물 및 변경 사항은 매년 정보통신망에 고시됩니다. 또한 행정정보 데이터세트의 경우 별도 관리기준표를 작성하여 운영합니다.

prefLabel.en: Election Commission Records Classification Standard Table
중앙선거관리위원회(National election commission of the republic of Korea, NEC)

en: The Classification of Juvenile Training Centers is the classification of juvenile detention centers pursuant to Article 3 of the Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Treatment of Protected Juvenile, etc. by classifying them into elementary and secondary education, vocational competency development training, medical rehabilitation, etc. by function, and multiple names may be used. Multiple names of juvenile centers shall be in accordance with the guidelines on the functions and multiple use of names of juvenile centers, etc
ko: 소년원의 분류(Classification of Juvenile Training Centers)는 보호소년 등의 처우에 관한 법률 시행령 제3조에 따라 소년원을 분류하는 것으로, 기능별로 초ㆍ중등교육, 직업능력개발훈련, 의료재활 등으로 분류하여 운영하고, 복수의 명칭을 사용할 수 있다. 소년원의 복수 명칭은 소년원 등의 기능 및 명칭 복수사용에 관한 지침에 따른다

en: The Classification of Fire Equipment is classified according to its purpose and function, and is stipulated in Articles 6 and [Attachment 1] of the Enforcement Decree of the same Act under Articles 2 (1) and 8 of the Fire Equipment Management Act. Matters concerning the classification criteria, procedures, detailed items, etc. of fire fighting equipment classified in the Enforcement Decree [Attachment 1] shall be prescribed in Articles 3 and 4 of the Regulations on the Classification of Fire Equipment, etc. and [Attachment 1].
ko: 소방장비의 분류(Classification of Fire Equipment)는 소방장비를 용도 및 기능에 따라 분류한 것으로, 소방장비관리법 제2조제1호 및 제8조에 따른 동법 시행령 제6조 및 [별표1]에서 정하고 있다. 시행령 [별표1] 에서 분류된 소방장비의 분류 기준•절차 및 소방장비의 세부적인 품목 등에 관한 사항은 소방장비 분류 등에 관한 규정 제3조 및 제4조, [별도표1]에서 정한다.

en: Veterinary medical terminology (English-Korean, Korean-English) is the first veterinary terminology published in 2006 jointly by the Korean Veterinary Society and the Korean Veterinary Society. It contributed greatly to education and research in the field of veterinary and livestock by unifying difficult Chinese character expressions and inaccurate foreign language notation of veterinary terms used at the time.
und: 수의학용어집(Veterinary medical terminology:English-Korean·Korean-English)은 2006년 대한수의학회와 대한수의사회 공동 주관으로 발간한 최초 수의학 용어집이다. 당시 사용되던 수의학 용어의 어려운 한자식 표현과 부정확한 외래어 표기를 통일하면서 수의•축산 분야의 교육과 연구에 크게 기여하였다.

en:
The list of infectious disease pathogens subject to import permission is a list of pathogens for infectious diseases of animals provided by the Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs Administration. It also provides a list of exemptions for import permission.


Article 32 (3) of the Livestock Infectious Disease Prevention Act and [Regulations on the Management of Veterinary Life Resources for Livestock Infectious Diseases Pathogens, etc.] *Release the list to the website of the Korea Veterinary Life Resources Bank (http://kahis.go.kr:9000/kvcc) at the bottom of Appendix 1 and **Attachment 2 from time to time.

*[Attached Table 1] Special management pathogens: Type 1 livestock infectious disease pathogens specified in the Livestock Infectious Disease Prevention Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Home Appliance Act") and pathogens designated by the head of the Agriculture, Forestry and Livestock Quarantine Headquarters (hereinafter referred to as the "head of the quarantine headquarters")

**[Attached Table 2] General management pathogens: Pathogens other than special management pathogens among Class 2 and 3 livestock infectious diseases specified in the Home Appliance Act, pathogens designated by the head of the quarantine headquarters (Attached Table 2), and other pathogens of infectious diseases of animals
und:
수입허가 대상 가축전염병 병원체 목록(List of infectious livestock pathogens subject to import permission)은 농림축산검역본부에서 제공하는 동물의 전염성 질병의 병원체 정보 중 수입허가 대상 목록이다. 수입허가 비대상목록도 같이 제공한다.


[가축전염병 예방법] 제32조 제3항 및 [가축전염병 병원체등 수의생명자원 관리규정] *별표1, **별표2 하단에 따라서 목록 변경시 수시로 한국수의생명자원은행 홈페이지(http://kahis.go.kr:9000/kvcc)에 공개한다.

*[별표1] 특별관리병원체 : 「가축전염병예방법」(이하 "가전법"이라 한다)에 명시된 제1종 가축전염병 병원체 및 농림축산검역본부장(이하 "검역본부장"이라 한다)이 지정한 병원체

**[별표2] 일반관리병원체 : 가전법에 명시된 제2ㆍ3종 가축전염병 병원체 중 특별관리병원체를 제외한 병원체, 검역본부장이 지정한 병원체(별표 2) 및 그 밖에 동물의 전염성 질병의 병원체

prefLabel.en: List of infectious livestock pathogens subject to import permission
농림축산식품부 농림축산검역본부(Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency)

en:
The treatment level of Sentenced Inmates is the treatment level of prisoners prescribed in Articles 72, 73, 74, and 76 of the Enforcement Regulations of the Penal Execution Act. The treatment level is divided into basic accommodation level, security treatment level, and individual treatment level.

Inmate: The term "inmate" means a person who has been sentenced to imprisonment, imprisonment, or detention and has been imprisoned in a correctional facility and has been imprisoned in a correctional facility with an order to attract a labor center for failing to pay fines or fines in full.
Treatment grade: The term "treatment grade" means a standard for distinguishing facilities to accommodate inmates, the degree of accounting for inmates, the level of treatment and the contents of treatment in relation to the treatment and management of inmates.
und:

en: "The conceptual list was prepared by deaf and hearing students of the Department of Psychology at the University of Hamburg, taking into account suggestions from deaf pedagogy as well as psychological and psychotherapeutic work with deaf people, including the introductory literature of the seven subject areas of general psychology, biopsychology, differential psychology , Developmental and pedagogic psychology, clinical psychology, cognitive psychology and social psychology, and was compared with already existing psychological specialties, with the aim of selecting a basic vocabulary for a psychological study at a predefined upper limit of about 1000 terms Of the employees from their studies were included in the selection.Systematic aspects could only be considered to a very limited extent Nter are references to the existing sign language variants for this entry. If you click on one of the reference pictures, the display will jump to the part of the lexicon entry belonging to this variant below. These include supplementary information on the lemma: common abbreviations (ABK), synonyms (AUCH), or, in the case of conceptual pairs, the connotation (eg 'Efference': 'AUCH: Gegenbegriff: Afferenz'). Below the definition text are listed the top terms to which the respective term can be assigned. The subject areas, with the exception of the applied psychology, are divided into a total of 37 terms. An upper term was recorded if at least 4 items could be assigned to it. The upper concepts were not further hierarchized among themselves, since this would have been possible only in very few cases. They also do not always agree with the terms of the technical terms, e.g. (Learning, observation, learning, distributed, etc.) are to be found under the heading 'learning and learning theories'. The lemmas, which could not be assigned to a specific concept within a discipline, are to be found under an umbrella term which is nominally identical to the subject area. The lexicon is primarily intended for deaf students and interpreters. However, it also offers valuable information and suggestions for all persons who use sign language in psychological contexts (psychologists, medical practitioners, educators, social workers / social workers and others). "
und: "Die Begriffsliste wurde von gehörlosen und hörenden Studierenden des Faches Psychologie an der Universität Hamburg erstellt, wobei Anregungen aus der Gehörlosenpädagogik sowie der psychologischen und psychotherapeutischen Arbeit mit gehörlosen Personen berücksichtigt wurden. Dabei wurde die einführende Literatur der sieben Fachgebiete Allgemeine Psychologie, Biopsychologie, Differentielle Psychologie, Entwicklungs- und Pädagogische Psychologie, Klinische Psychologie, Kognitive Psychologie und Sozialpsychologie zugrunde gelegt und mit bereits existierenden psychologischen Fachlexika abgeglichen. Ziel war es, bei einer vorgegebenen Obergrenze von ca. 1000 Begriffen ein Basisvokabular auszuwählen, das für ein Psychologiestudium unerläßlich ist. Eigene Erfahrungen der Mitarbeiter aus ihrem Studium flossen in die Auswahl mit ein. Systematische Gesichtspunkte konnten nur sehr begrenzt berücksichtigt werden. Hinter dem Fachbegriff wird die englische Übersetzung angegeben, darunter befinden sich Verweise auf die vorhandenen gebärdensprachlichen Varianten zu diesem Eintrag. Klicken Sie eines der Verweisbilder an, so springt die Anzeige auf den zu dieser Variante gehörenden Teil des Lexikoneintrags weiter unten. Hierunter stehen ergänzende Angaben zum Lemma: geläufige Abkürzungen (ABK.), synonyme Bezeichnungen (AUCH) oder bei Begriffspaaren der dazugehörige Gegenbegriff (z.B. bei 'Efferenz': 'AUCH: Gegenbegriff: Afferenz'). Unter dem Definitionstext werden die Oberbegriffe aufgelistet, denen der jeweilige Begriff zugeordnet werden kann. Die Fachgebiete, mit Ausnahme der Angewandten Psychologie, sind in insgesamt 37 Oberbegriffe unterteilt. Ein Oberbegriff wurde aufgenommen, wenn mindestens 4 Begriffe diesem zugeordnet werden konnten. Die Oberbegriffe wurden untereinander nicht weiter hierarchisiert, da dies nur in sehr wenigen Fällen möglich gewesen wäre. Sie stimmen auch nicht immer mit den Bezeichnungen der Fachbegriffe überein, z.B. sind unter dem Oberbegriff 'Lernen und Lerntheorien' alle Einträge zu diesem Gebiet zu finden (Lernen, Beobachtungslernen, Lernen, verteiltes usw.). Die Lemmata, denen innerhalb eines Fachgebietes kein spezifischer Oberbegriff zugewiesen werden konnte, finden sich unter einem Oberbegriff, der namensidentisch mit der Fachgebietsbezeichnung ist. Gedacht ist das Lexikon in erster Linie für gehörlose Studierende und DolmetscherInnen. Es bietet jedoch auch für alle Personen, die Gebärdensprache in psychologischen Zusammenhängen anwenden (Psychologen, Mediziner, Pädagogen, Sozialpädagogen / Sozialarbeiter und andere), wertvolle Informationen und Anregungen."

en:
The Trade Secret Classification Guide is a guide for calculating and classifying secret grades of information and data held by companies.

Technology information such as R&D and production and management information such as personnel, general affairs, accounting, purchase and sales are representative of the information held by companies. Such information can be protected as trade secrets only when it meets economic usefulness, non-publicity, and confidentiality. In particular, the court makes it a major criterion for reviewing whether general information and trade secrets are separately managed when determining whether confidential management is satisfied in the event of a trade secret leakage accident.

However, companies have complained of difficulties in classifying and rating their information because there has been no adequate standard for systematic secret grade classification so far.

Accordingly, it is intended to support companies to efficiently establish trade secret management strategies by presenting the criteria for selecting appropriate protection measures (patents, trade secrets, etc.) for information held by companies, and by presenting a method of calculating the grade of information managed as trade secrets and an appropriate level of management for each grade.

This guide was derived through the research ⌋ (Korea Intellectual Property Office, 2016) to establish a classification system for ⌈ trade secret data, and can be modified and utilized to suit the reality of each company.
und:
영업비밀 등급분류 가이드(Trade Secret Classification Guide)는 기업이 보유하고 있는 정보·자료의 비밀등급 산정과 분류를 위한 안내서이다.

기업이 보유하고 있는 정보는 연구개발, 생산제조 등의 기술정보와 인사, 총무, 회계, 구매 및 판매 등의 경영정보가 대표적이다. 이러한 정보는 경제적 유용성, 비공지성, 비밀관리성을 충족해야만 영업비밀로 보호를 받을 수가 있으며, 특히 법원에서는 영업비밀 유출사고 발생시 비밀관리성 충족여부를 판단할 때 일반정보와 영업비밀을 구분해서 관리하였는지를 주요 검토기준으로 삼고 있다.

그러나, 현재까지 체계적인 비밀등급 분류에 대한 적당한 기준이 없어 기업들은 자사 정보에 대한 분류 및 등급 부여에 어려움을 호소하고 있었다.

이에, 기업이 보유한 정보를 대상으로 적절한 보호수단(특허, 영업비밀 등)을 선택하는 기준을 제시하고, 영업 비밀로 관리되는 정보의 등급을 산정하는 방법과 등급별 적절한 관리 수준을 개략적으로 제시함으로써, 기업이 효율적으로 영업비밀 관리전략을 수립할 수 있도록 지원하고자 한다.

본 가이드는 ⌈영업비밀 자료 등급분류 체계 마련 연구⌋ (특허청, 2016)를 통해 도출된 방안이며 각 기업의 현실에 맞도록 수정하여 활용 가능하다.

en:
Korean Thesaurus: The relationship between the description of terms and terms (Choi's Thesaurus) is a control vocabulary for Korean words that structures the relationship between the semantic information of terms and related terms.

Most algorithms for processing unstructured data have already been developed and known, but structured data are required to process them more precisely. To this end, terms have been collected since 1993 under the goal of constructing metadata for Korean terms that have a relationship between semantic information and terms, and they have been described as standard thesaurus structure. Thesaurus is widely known as a form of structuring terms and concisely abstracts complex relationships between terms. In this dictionary, the standard thesaurus structure is basically adopted and additionally expanded.

The subject of the registered terms includes nouns such as subject name, life, institution/organization name, place name, animal name, plant name, legal name, literature name, monument name, product name, meeting/assembly name, event name, etc., and verbs and adjectives. As of August 2013, 1.3 million terms (800,000 terms in Korean, 510,000 terms in foreign language. See statistical functions for more information) were registered and terminology relationships were defined. Although it is not yet sufficient, it is thought that we have constructed a sufficient amount of data to process unstructured data in the field to some extent, so we will disclose the results so far. More than 10,000 terms of new terms are added every month, and this work will continue along with the revision work.
ko:
우리말 시소러스 : 용어의 설명과 용어 간의 관계(Choi’s Thesaurus)는 용어의 의미 정보와 관련 용어 간의 관계를 구조화하고 있는 우리말에 대한 통제 어휘 사전이다.

비구조화 데이터를 처리하기 위한 대부분의 알고리즘은 이미 개발되어 알려져 있으나 이를 보다 정교하게 처리하기 위해서는 구조화 데이터가 필요하다. 이를 위하여 의미 정보와 용어 간의 관계를 갖는 우리말 용어의 메타데이터를 구축한다는 목표 아래 1993년부터 용어를 수집하고 이를 표준 시소러스 구조로 기술하고 있다. 시소러스는 용어의 구조화 형식으로 널리 알려져 있으며 용어 간의 복잡한 관계를 간결하게 추상화하고 있다. 본 사전에서는 기본적으로 표준 시소러스 구조를 채택하고 부가적으로 이를 확장하고 있다.

등재 용어의 대상으로는 주제명, 인명, 기관/단체명, 지명, 동물명, 식물명, 법률명, 문헌명, 기념물명, 상품명, 회의/집회명, 사건명 등의 명사류, 그리고 동사와 형용사를 포함시키고 있다. 2013년 8월 현재 130만 용어(한글 용어 80만 용어, 외국어 51만 용어. 상세한 것은 통계기능 참조)를 등재하고 용어 관계를 정의하였다. 아직 충분하지는 않으나 이제 현장의 비구조화 데이터를 어느정도 처리할 수 있는 양의 데이터를 구축하였다고 생각하여 지금까지의 결과를 공개하기로 한다. 매월 1만 용어 이상의 새로운 용어를 추가하고 있으며, 이 작업은 수정 작업과 함께 계속될 것이다.

en:
Urimalsaem is a user-participating dictionary that collects and creates words used in real life, newly emerged words, and words used in the region with the people.


Introduce the Korean language fountain

1. What's a Korean word fountain?

When I'm curious about the use of Korean, I look for a Korean dictionary. However, there are times when I feel disappointed because there is no information or it is difficult to explain even when I look for a dictionary. This is because there are various restrictions on the dictionaries published so far, so the information has been compressed and included in a limited way.

The Korean Language Sam, in which the user participates, was designed to overcome this problem. All of us who speak Korean want to be the main subjects and include vocabulary that was used before or is currently used in a more diverse and easy-to-understand manner. In addition to traditional dictionary information, it also aims to provide various language knowledge to answer many questions about the Korean language.

'Korean Horse Spring' encompasses various fields such as new words, dialects, and technical terms.

It started with a million words, but the number will continue to increase.

In "Korean Sam," anyone interested in Korean can participate in editing.
Until now, editing of dictionaries has been exclusive to dictionary experts. "Korean Language Sam" opens up editing so that anyone interested in Korean can share their Korean knowledge.

"Korean Horse Sam" aims to increase the reliability of the information contained through expert supervision.
In "Korean Horse Sam," experts from each field participate to check the newly edited content and refine the expression.

und:
우리말샘(Urimalsaem)은 실생활에서 쓰는 말, 새로이 나타난 말, 지역에서 쓰는 말 등을 국민과 함께 모으고 만들어가는 사용자 참여형 사전이다.


우리말샘 소개

1. 우리말샘이란?

우리말의 쓰임이 궁금할 때 국어사전을 찾게 됩니다. 그런데 막상 사전을 찾아도 정보가 없거나 설명이 어려워 아쉬움을 느낄 때가 있습니다. 그동안 간행된 사전들은 여러 가지 제약이 있어 정보를 압축하여 제한적으로 수록하였기 때문입니다.

사용자가 참여하는 ‘우리말샘’은 이런 문제점을 극복하고자 기획되었습니다. 한국어를 사용하는 우리 모두가 주체가 되어 예전에 사용되었거나 현재 사용되고 있는 어휘를 더욱 다양하고 알기 쉽게 수록하고자 합니다. 또한 전통적인 사전 정보 이외에 다양한 언어 지식도 실어 한국어에 관한 많은 궁금증을 푸는 통로가 되고자 합니다.

‘우리말샘’은 신어, 방언, 전문 용어 등 다양한 분야를 아우릅니다.
국립국어원에서 간행한 ‘표준국어대사전’에 실린 말뿐만 아니라, 그동안 국어사전에서는 싣지 않았으나 실제로 쓰이는 말들도 대폭 실었습니다. 100만 어휘로 출발했지만 앞으로 그 수는 계속 늘어날 것입니다.

‘우리말샘’에서는 한국어에 관심 있는 모든 사람이 편집에 참여할 수 있습니다.
지금까지 사전의 편집은 사전 전문가들만의 영역이었습니다. ‘우리말샘’은 한국어에 관심이 있는 모든 사람이 자신이 가진 한국어 지식을 나눌 수 있도록 편집을 개방합니다.

‘우리말샘’은 전문가 감수를 통해 수록된 정보의 신뢰도를 높이고자 합니다.
‘우리말샘’에서는 각 분야 전문가들이 참여하여 새롭게 편집된 내용을 확인하고 표현을 가다듬습니다.


2. 우리말샘의 특징

개방성
-  신어, 방언, 전문 용어 등 다양한 분야의 한국어 자료 수록
-  일반 사용자가 편집에 참여
-  자유 저작권 정책에 기반을 둔 지식 기부로 수록 정보의 자유로운 활용

연계성
- 국내외 기관과의 정보 교류, 연계가 가능하도록 국제 표준 규격 준용
- 휴대용 기기, 인터넷 사이트 등에서 정보의 2차 활용성 강화

실용성
- 일반 대중이 필요로 하는 다양한 언어 정보 제공
- 사용자가 쉽게 사용할 수 있는 웹 기반 환경 적용

en: The Business Reference Model (BRM) classifies administrative agency tasks based on unique functions and defines classified tasks and related information. The classification system by function systematizes them into policy fields, policy areas, large functions, medium functions, small functions, and unit tasks. This system is designed to clearly define and efficiently manage the tasks performed by the government, and related data can be found in the Ministry of Public Administration and Security and the Government Organization Management Information System. The term "functional classification of administrative affairs" (hereinafter referred to as "functional classification") means classifying the affairs of an administrative agency based on its own functions and defining information related to the classified affairs. The "classification system for each function" classifies the duties regularly performed by the government into policy fields, policy areas, major functions, medium functions, small functions, and unit tasks according to the level of function.
und: 정부기능분류체계(Business Reference Model, BRM)는 행정기관의 업무를 고유한 기능 중심으로 분류하고, 분류된 업무와 관련 정보를 정의한다. 기능별 분류체계는 이를 정책분야, 정책영역, 대기능, 중기능, 소기능, 단위과제로 체계화한다. 이 체계는 정부가 수행하는 업무를 명확히 정의하고 효율적으로 관리하기 위해 설계되었으며, 관련 자료는 행정안전부 및 정부조직관리정보시스템에서 확인 가능하다. “행정업무의 기능분류(이하 “기능분류”라 한다)”라 함은 행정기관의 업무를 고유한 기능을 중심으로 분류하고, 분류된 업무와 관련된 정보를 정의하는 것을 말한다. “기능별 분류체계”는 정부가 상시적으로 수행하는 업무를 기능수준에 따라 정책분야ㆍ정책영역․대기능․중기능․소기능․단위과제로 분류한다.

prefLabel.en: 행정안전부(Ministry of the Interior and Safety)

en: The Grading of Major Communications Facilities (Grading of Major Communications Facilities) is based on the criteria by which major telecommunication business operators classify facilities that need protection in consideration of the matters referred to in Article 23-3 (1) of the Enforcement Decree of the Framework Act on Broadcasting and Communication Development.
und: 중요통신시설 등급 지정기준(Grading of Major Communications Facilities)은 주요통신사업자가 통신국사, 분기국사, 기지국 집중국사 및 집적정보통신시설을 대상으로 방송통신발전 기본법 시행령 제23조의3제1항 각 호의 사항을 고려하여 보호가 필요한 시설에 대해 등급을 분류하는 기준으로, 주요통신사업자의 통신시설 등급 지정 및 관리기준 [별표1] 중요통신시설 등급 지정기준에 따라 분류한다.

en: The Ironmaking Technology in the Jungwon Region: A List of Ironmaking Sites shows that the Jungwon region is optimized for iron production thanks to the Namhan River water system and its abundant resources such as iron ore, charcoal, and clay. About 20 ironmaking sites have been excavated from the Three Kingdoms period to the Joseon Dynasty in Chungcheongbuk-do, and in particular, in Chungju, 96 ironmaking sites and 456 coal tanks were identified at 45 sites, proving that iron production was actively carried out. Representative relics include Jincheon Seokjang-ri, Gusan-ri, Chungju Chilgeum-dong, Daehwa-ri, and Cheongwon Yeonje-ri.
und: 중원지역 제철기술:제철유적 목록(Ironmaking Technology in the Jungwon Region: A List of Ironmaking Sites)은 남한강 수계와 풍부한 철광석, 목탄, 점토 등의 자원 덕분에 중원지역이 철 생산에 최적화된 지역임을 보여줍니다. 충청북도에서 삼국시대부터 조선시대까지 약 20여 곳의 제철유적이 발굴되었으며, 특히 충주에서는 96개소의 제철유적과 45개소에서 456기의 탄요가 확인되어 철 생산이 활발히 이루어졌음을 증명합니다. 대표적인 유적으로는 진천 석장리, 구산리, 충주 칠금동, 대화리, 청원 연제리 등이 있습니다.

prefLabel.en: Ironmaking Technology in the Jungwon Region: A List of Ironmaking Sites

en: The Severity Classification Table is a method of classifying casualties occurring at a disaster site. The rules on emergency rescue response activities and on-site command are in accordance with the severity classification table in Appendix 7, and are classified into four stages: death, emergency, emergency, and non-emergency.
und: 중증도 분류표(Severity Classification Table)는 재난현장에서 발생한 사상자의 분류 방법이다. 긴급구조대응활동 및 현장지휘에 관한 규칙 [별표7] 중증도 분류표에 따르며, 사망ㆍ긴급ㆍ응급 및 비응급의 4단계로 분류한다.

en: Earthquake Terminology is a terminology description of earthquakes among earthquake information (common sense related to earthquakes) provided by the Jeju Disaster and Safety Countermeasures Headquarters. It provides terminology and brief explanations.
ko: 지진 용어해설(Earthquake Terms)은 Jeju 재난안전대책본부에서 제공하는 지진정보(지진 관련 상식) 중 지진에 관한 용어해설이다. 용어와 간단 설명을 제공한다.

en:
A portrait is a painting of a specific person. In ancient documents, the names Jin 眞, Yeong 影, Jinyoung 眞影, Yeongjeong 影幀, and Burn 畫 were used. During the Joseon Dynasty, as the idea of Sunghyeon, which honors and honors ancestors, became widespread, portraits of kings and royal figures or ordinary nobles were actively produced.

The National Institute of Cultural Heritage's Art and Cultural Heritage Research Center will push for the "Korea Portrait DB Construction Project" to make it easier and more convenient for Koreans to find state-designated portraits scattered across the country in one place. In particular, we would like to contribute to the research and enjoyment of our art heritage by allowing us to look at portraits that were difficult for the general public to access because they were owned by individuals, families, and private institutions in ultra-high-resolution images of more than 100 million pixels.

The number of state-designated portraits to be presented in this project is 83 cases and 131 national treasures, 7 national treasures, 76 treasures, and 106 portraits are as follows.
und:
초상화는 특정 인물의 모습을 그린 그림입니다. 옛 문헌에는 ‘진眞’, ‘영影’, ‘상像’, ‘진영眞影’, ‘영정影幀’, ‘화상畫像’ 등의 명칭으로 기록되어 있습니다. 조선 시대에는 선현들을 기리고 모시는 숭현사상이 널리 퍼지면서 왕과 왕실의 인물이나 나라에 공을 세운 공신과 일반 사대부를 그린 초상화가 활발하게 제작되었습니다.

국립문화유산연구원 미술문화유산연구실은 우리 국민들이 전국에 흩어져 있는 국가지정 초상화를 한 곳에서 보다 쉽고 편리하게 찾아보실 수 있도록 「한국의 초상화 DB 구축 사업」을 추진합니다. 특히 개인이나 문중, 사립기관 등이 소장하고 있어 일반인이 접근하기 어려웠던 초상화를 1억 화소 이상의 초고해상도 이미지로 살펴보실 수 있게 하여 우리 미술유산의 연구와 향유 증진에 기여하고자 합니다.

이번 사업에서 선보일 국가지정 초상화는 83건 131점으로, 국보 7건 25점, 보물 76건 106점이며, 초상화의 형식은 다음과 같습니다.

prefLabel.en: 국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage, NRICH)

en:
The Taekwondo Terminology is a complete revision of the Taekwondo Technical Dictionary published by Kukkiwon in 2010.

The 215-page dictionary summarized the terms by dividing the Taekwondo skill system diagram into △ attack techniques (scratching, stabbing, shooting, hitting, kicking, breaking, turning over), △ defense techniques (blocking, subtracting, avoiding) △ assistive techniques (standing, jumping, catching, pushing, preparation posture, special items).

The term dictionary contains not only the terms and meanings of each technology, but also examples in which the terms can be used in various ways and useful information not presented in the meaning solving.

In particular, the institute tried to help readers understand by including photos of members of the Taekwondo Demonstration Team of Kukkiwon, which embodied terms in the dictionary of terms.

In addition, all technologies posted in the term dictionary can be checked by video using QR codes.
und:
태권도 용어 사전(Taekwondo Terminology)은 2010년 국기원에서 발간한 태권도기술용어집의 전면개정판이다.

총 215쪽 분량의 용어사전은 태권도 기술 체계도를 △공격기술(지르기, 찌르기, 찍기, 치기, 차기, 꺾기, 넘기기) △방어기술(막기, 빼기, 피하기) △보조기술(서기, 딛기, 뛰기, 잡기, 밀기, 준비자세, 특수품) 등으로 구분해 용어를 정리했다.

용어사전은 각 기술의 용어와 뜻풀이는 물론 용어가 다양하게 활용될 수 있는 예시, 뜻풀이에 제시하지 않은 유용한 정보까지 담았다.

특히 연구소는 용어사전에 용어를 형상화한 국기원 태권도시범단 단원들의 사진을 수록, 독자들의 이해를 돕기 위해 노력했다.

이밖에도 QR코드를 활용해 용어사전에 게재된 모든 기술들을 영상으로 확인할 수 있도록 했다.

en: The Standard Terminology Dictionary is a service that allows the National Institute of Technology and Standards to build and search 100,000 KS terms (the terms that exist in the KS standard book) in a database (DB) through e-National Standard Certification (www.standards.go.kr ), an integrated government-wide standard and certification search portal. Through the standard term dictionary search, industrial and academic workers can easily find and use technical terms.
und: 표준용어사전(Standard Terminology Dictionary)은 국가기술표준원이 범정부 표준·인증 통합검색 포털인 이(e)-나라표준인증(www.standards.go.kr)을 통해 KS 용어(KS표준서에 존재하는 용어) 10만여건을 데이터베이스(DB)로 구축하여 검색할 수 있도록 제공하는 서비스이다. 표준용어사전 검색을 통해 산업계·학계 종사자들이 전문기술용어를 쉽게 찾아보고 활용할 수 있다.

prefLabel.en: 국가기술표준원(Korean Agency for Technology and Standards)

und: Taxonomy of Key Inventory Types or Categorizations

en:
"The following represents a linear or flat taxonomy of key Inventories that are used and should be maintained by Information Technology (IT) organizations and professionals. Such Inventories help define, structure, organize, and understand various forms of Data, Information, and Knowledge that are important to IT Organizations, IT Professionals, and their Business Stakeholders. Specifically, maintaining current and up to date Inventories is a best practice that ensures better transparency into the enterprise and which leads to good operational metrics for better decision making.

Such a Taxonomy is often used as a foundation for data modeling, especially in the design, definition, and implementation of other Taxonomies and Ontologies. These constructs are also often used as mechanisms to provide clarity and standardize terminology for communications between business stakeholders and IT organizations."

The Dictionary of Korean Archaeology contains definitions of terms that are essential for understanding Korean archaeology and summarize the most basic concepts and important relics excavated and investigated in Korea
ko: 한국고고학사전(Dictionary of Korean Archaeology)은 한국 고고학을 이해하는데 필수적이면서도 가장 기본적인 개념을 정리한 용어에 대한 정의와 우리나라에서 발굴 조사된 중요유적들에 대한 개괄적인 내용을 수록하였다

prefLabel.en: 국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage, NRICH)

en: The Dictionary of Korean Archaeology (2014) is an English version of the dictionary using the Korean archaeological dictionary and specialized dictionary by field to share representative research results of Korean archaeology with foreign academia and enhance foreign researchers' understanding of Korean ancient history. It includes the definition of terms that are essential for understanding Korean archaeology and summarize the most basic concepts and important relics excavated and investigated in Korea. It also introduced related relics from neighboring countries, such as Japan, China, and Russia, which are directly related to Korean archaeology.
ko: 한국고고학사전(영문판)(Dictionary of Korean Archaeology(English Edition)(2014)은 한국고고학의 대표적인 연구 성과를 국외 학계와 공유하고, 국외 연구자들의 한국고대사에 대한 이해도를 제고하고자 그간의 한국고고학사전 및 분야별 전문사전을 활용한 영문판 사전이다. 여기에는 한국 고고학을 이해하는데 필수적이면서도 가장 기본적인 개념을 정리한 용어에 대한 정의와 우리나라에서 발굴 조사된 중요유적들에 대한 개괄적인 내용을 수록 하였습니다. 또한 한국고고학과 직접적으로 연관되는 일본, 중국, 러시아 등 인접 국가의 관련 유적들도 소개하였다.

prefLabel.en: 국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage, NRICH)

en: The Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:Burial Goods in the Ancient Korean Graves((韓國考古學專門事典:古墳遺物篇) contains terminology explanations for more than 600 important artifacts excavated from ancient tombs in Korea, making it easier for the general public to understand difficult archaeological terms.
ko: 한국고고학전문사전:고분유물편(韓國考古學專門事典:古墳遺物篇, Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:Burial Goods in the Ancient Korean Graves)은 우리나라 고대 고분에서 출토된 중요 유물 600여 건에 대한 용어해설을 도면·사진과 함께 수록하여, 어려운 고고학 용어를 일반인이 이해하기 쉽게 정리하였다.

prefLabel.en: Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:Burial Goods in the Ancient Korean Graves
국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage, NRICH)

en: The Dictionary of Korean Archaeology: Ancient Tombs((韓國考古學專門事典:古墳篇) compiled relics and conceptual terms from the end of the early Iron Age to Unified Silla, and includes materials related to Korean history located not only on the Korean Peninsula but also outside China and Japan.
ko: 한국고고학전문사전:고분편(韓國考古學專門事典:古墳篇, Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:Ancient Tombs) 은 초기철기 말기 무렵무터 통일신라까지의 유적 및 개념 용어를 집대성하였고, 한반도뿐만 아니라 중국·일본 등 국외에 소재하는 우리 역사 관련 자료도 포함되어 있다.

prefLabel.en: 국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage, NRICH)

en: The Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:The Paleolithic(韓國考古學專門事典:舊石器時代篇) is divided into categories of concepts, relics, achievements, and the status of world-famous Paleolithic ruins in Korea, and consists of more than 500 terminology explanations, drawings, and plates, as well as the distribution of historical headings by region and personality.
ko: 한국고고학전문사전:구석기시대편(韓國考古學專門事典:舊石器時代篇, Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:The Paleolithic)은 우리나라 구석기 시대 고고학의 개념, 유물, 성과는 물론 세계적으로 유명한 구석기 시대 유적의 현황 등을 범주로 나누어 500여 건에 관한 용어 해설과 도면·도판으로 구성되었으며, 유적표제어의 지역별·성격별 분포도도 함께 수록하였다.

prefLabel.en: 국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage)

en: The Dictionary of Korean Archaeology: The Paleolithic (English Edition) is an English version of the "Korean Archaeological Dictionary - The Paleolithic," published in Korean by the National Institute of Cultural Heritage in 2013, and contains the research results of the Korean Paleolithic Age, which have been excavated and investigated until recently, including previously included contents. 73 important Paleolithic sites excavated in Korea, such as the title of "Research Status and Tasks of the Paleolithic Age in Korea" and the "Pocheon Neulgeori Ruins," were selected as the title words, and the research results were included along with photos and drawings.
und: 한국고고학전문사전:구석기시대편(영문판)(Dictionary of Korean Archaeology : The Paleolithic(English Edition)은 국립문화유산연구원에서 2013년에 한글판으로 발간한『한국고고학전문사전-구석기시대편』의 영문판으로, 기존에 수록된 내용을 포함하여 최근까지 발굴 조사된 한국 구석기시대의 연구 성과를 증보하여 수록한 것이다. ‘한국 구석기시대의 연구 현황과 과제’ 표제어와 ‘포천 늘거리 유적’ 등 최근까지 우리나라에서 발굴 조사된 중요 구석기시대 유적 73개소를 표제어로 선정하여 이에 관한 조사 연구 성과를 사진·도면과 함께 수록하였다.

prefLabel.en: Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:The Paleolithic(English Edition)
국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage, NRICH)

en: The Dictionary of Korean Archaeology: Production Sites is a collection of research results related to production sites such as kilns, ironmaking, and workshops on the Korean Peninsula, and includes 342 conceptual titles and 1,513 historical titles.
ko: 한국고고학전문사전:생산유적편(Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:Production Sites)은 한반도 내 가마, 제철, 공방 등 생산유적 관련 조사연구 성과를 집대성한 사전으로, 가마나 제철 공방 등 생산과 관련된 유적의 현황과 개념 및 관련 개념들의 용어를 총 정리하여, 개념표제어 342건, 유적표제어 1,513건 총 1,855건을 수록하였다.

prefLabel.en: 국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage, NRICH)

en: The Dictionary of Korean Archaeology: Catles (Signal Fires) is a dictionary that compiles the results of research on fortresses and beacon in Korean archaeology and prepares an official term unification plan.
ko: 한국고고학전문사전:성곽·봉수편(Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:CatlesㆍSignal Fires)은 한국고고학의 성곽 및 봉수에 대한 그간의 연구성과를 집대성하고, 공인된 용어 통일안을 마련한 사전이다.

prefLabel.en: 국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage, NRICH)

en: The Dictionary of Korean Archaeology: Neolithic Age describes the achievements of archaeology in the Korean Neolithic Age by dividing the achievements of archaeology into categories such as relics, relics, and concepts, explaining the terms and organizing the main data. In addition to the Korean Peninsula, research results from regions close to our Neolithic culture, such as China, Japan, and Russia, were included, and drawings and plates were included to help readers understand using this dictionary.
ko: 한국고고학전문사전:신석기시대편(Dictionary of Korean Archaeology:Neolithic Age)은 한국 신석기 시대 고고학의 성과를 유적과 유물, 개념 등의 범주로 나누어 용어를 해설하고 주료 자료를 정리하여 수록하였다. 한반도 외에도 중국, 일본, 러시아 등 우리의 신석기문화와 밀접한 지역의 연구 성과가 포함되었고, 도면과 도판을 수록하여 이 사전을 이용하는 독자의 이해를 돕고자 하였다.

prefLabel.en: 국립문화유산연구원(National Research Institute of Cultural Heritage, NRICH)

en: It is an augmented edition dictionary composed of domestic (I·II) and foreign (III) by supplementing the latest research results made since the publication of the Dictionary of Korean Archaeology: The Bronze Age in 2004, and contains a total of 2,132 cases, including 221 conceptual headings (130 domestic and 91 overseas) and 1,911 historical headings (1516 domestic and 395 overseas).

en: "The following represents a linear or flat taxonomy of key IT Disciplines that are used by Information Technology (IT) organizations and professionals to help define, structure, organize, and understand various forms of Data, Information, and Knowledge associated with the many Discplines performed by IT Organizations and their IT Professionals, both, for themselves and for their business stakeholders. The Korean National Encyclopedia of Korean Culture was created as a result of a long-term research project in Korea after 1980 by compiling Korean culture for the first time. It contains the most authoritative knowledge information about Korean culture and was written by professional researchers in each field of Korean studies. It is an encyclopedia that allows you to understand the in-depth of Korean culture, such as "Laughter," "恨," and "ghost." It is a dictionary of encyclopedia that does not stop making revisions in order to be reborn as a dictionary that meets the demands of the times.
ko: 한국민족문화대백과사전(Encyclopedia of Korea Culture)은 한국 최초로 한국 문화를 집대성하여 1980년 이후 한국한 연구 장기 프로젝트의 결과로 탄생하였다. 한국 문화에 대한 가장 권위 있는 지식 정보를 담고 있으며, 한국학 각 분야의 전문 연구자들이 집필하였다. '웃음’, ‘한(恨)’, ‘귀신’ 등 우리문화의 심층을 이해할 수 있수 있으며, 시대 요청에 부응하는 사전으로 거듭나기 위해 개정 증보를 멈추지 않는 대백과사전입니다.

en: The Korean Classification of Crime for Statistical Purpose (KCCS) is a classification system based on the International Classification of Crime for Statistics (ICCS) adopted by the UN Statistical Commission (UNSC) in March 2015. It is a classification to increase the consistency and comparability of crime statistics, and in the classification, 'crime' is regarded as a violation 'action' that exceeds the limit of human behavior punishable by law. It is important to note when using the classification that the Korean Crime Classification is a classification for the purpose of collecting and using statistics, and crime is systematically categorized (classified) according to the type of behavior, and may differ from the existing criminal justice statistics.
und: 한국범죄분류(Korean Classification of Crime for Statistical purposes, KCCS)는 2015년 3월 유엔통계위원회(UNSC, UN Statistical Commission)에서 채택한 국제범죄분류(ICCS, International Classification of Crime for Statistics purposes)를 기반으로 작성한 분류체계이다. 범죄통계의 일관성과 비교성을 높이기 위한 분류이며, 분류 상 ‘범죄’는 법에 따라 처벌 가능한 인간 행동 한계를 넘는 위반 ‘행위’로 간주한다. 분류 이용시 유의할 점은, 한국범죄분류는 통계 수집 및 활용 목적의 분류이며, 범죄를 행위유형에 따라 체계적으로 유형화(분류)한 것으로 기존 형사사법통계의 작성 기준과 다를 수 있다.

en:
Polk Religion of Villages in Korea is a survey of village community beliefs that are currently handed down at the National Folk Museum of Korea. Due to various factors such as industrialization, urbanization, and migration, village beliefs are rapidly disappearing, and the scale is reduced in local village communities, including large cities, and the form is changing briefly, but village beliefs are still being handed down. This is because there are still people who try to protect village beliefs. From this point of view, it is necessary to observe and record how village beliefs are maintained and how they are changing.

In 2007, the National Folk Museum of Korea published an on-site survey report on Korean village beliefs on a nationwide basis from 2005 to 2006. In addition, from 2022, the National Folk Museum of Korea divides the whole country into six regions, including Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Gyeongsang, Jeolla, Chungcheong, Gangwon, and Jeju, and conducts a survey of village beliefs by region and records them. Through the record of the survey table on the status of village beliefs included in the survey report, it is possible to find out whether the village beliefs continue and disappear over time.
und:
한국의 마을신앙(Folk religion of villages in Korea)은 국립민속박물관에서 현재 전승되는 마을공동체 신앙에 대하여 조사한 것이다. 산업화, 도시화, 이주 등의 다양한 요인으로 인해 마을신앙은 빠르게 사라지고, 대도시를 비롯한 지역의 마을 공동체에서는 그 규모는 축소되고, 형식은 간략하게 바뀌어 가지만, 여전히 마을신앙이 전해오고 있다. 이는 마을신앙을 지키기 위해 노력하는 사람들이 여전히 존재하고 있기 때문이다. 이러한 관점에서 마을신앙이 어떻게 유지되고 있는지, 어떻게 변화되고 있는지 등에 관해 관찰하고, 기록할 필요가 있다.

2007년에 국립민속박물관은 2005년~2006년에 걸쳐 전국적 단위로 한국의 마을신앙을 조사한 현장 조사보고서를 냈다. 그리고, 2022년부터 국립민속박물관은 서울•경기•인천권, 경상권, 전라권, 충청권, 강원권, 제주권 등 전국을 여섯 개의 권역으로 나누고, 권역별 마을신앙 조사를 시행하여 기록하고 있다. 조사보고서에 수록된 마을신앙 현황조사표 기록을 통해 시간에 따른 마을신앙의 지속여부와 소멸 여부를 알 수 있다.

en:
South Korea's Village Faith: Gwangju Metropolitan City, South Jeolla Province (Polk Religion of Villages in Korea - Wangju Metropolitan City and Jeolanam-do)

Starting in 2022, the National Folk Museum of Korea has divided the whole country into six regions, including Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Gyeongsang, Jeolla, Chungcheong, Gangwon, and Jeju, and is conducting a survey on village beliefs by region. Due to various factors such as industrialization, urbanization, and migration, village beliefs are rapidly disappearing, and the scale is reduced and the form is changed briefly in local village communities, including large cities, but village beliefs are still being handed down. This is because there are still people who try to protect village beliefs. From this point of view, it was necessary to observe and record how village beliefs are maintained and how they are changing.

In 2023, a survey of village beliefs was conducted in the Jeolla and Jeju areas. As a result, a report on village beliefs (total of 3 volumes) in ⌈ Korea was published following the Chungcheong area in 2022. This report is composed of three volumes: Gwangju Metropolitan City and Jeollanam-do, Jeollabuk-do, and Jeju Special Self-Governing Province. In Gwangju Metropolitan City and Jeollanam-do, a total of 49 regions, including 7 Gwangju Metropolitan City and 42 Jeollanam-do, were included. And in Jeollabuk-do, 35 regions of village beliefs were included. In addition, 40 regions of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province included village beliefs. Meanwhile, each report included a list of whether or not it was transmitted for comparison with the 2007 survey on the current status of village beliefs.
und:
한국의 마을신앙:광주광역시, 전라남도(Folk religion of villages in Korea - Gwangju Metropolitan City and Jeollanam-do)

2022년부터 국립민속박물관은 서울•경기•인천권, 경상권, 전라권, 충청권, 강원권, 제주권 등 전국을 여섯 개의 권역으로 나누고, 권역별 마을신앙 조사를 시행하고 있다. 산업화, 도시화, 이주 등의 다양한 요인으로 인해 마을신앙은 빠르게 사라지고, 대도시를 비롯한 지역의 마을 공동체에서는 그 규모는 축소되고, 형식은 간략하게 바뀌어 가지만, 여전히 마을신앙이 전해오고 있다. 이는 마을신앙을 지키기 위해 노력하는 사람들이 여전히 존재하고 있기 때문이다. 이러한 관점에서 마을신앙이 어떻게 유지되고 있는지, 어떻게 변화되고 있는지 등에 관해 관찰하고, 기록할 필요가 있었다.

2023년에는 전라권과 제주권을 대상으로 마을신앙 조사를 시행하였다. 그 결과 2022년 충청권에 이어 ⌈한국의 마을신앙(전라•제주권) 조사보고서 (총3권).⌋를 발간하게 되었다. 본 보고서는 광주광역시•전라남도 1권, 전라북도 1권, 제주특별자치도 1권으로 총 3권으로 구성되었다. 광주광역시•전라남도에서는 광주광역시 7곳, 전라남도 42곳 등 총 49개 지역이 수록되었다. 그리고 전라북도에서는 35개 지역의 마을신앙이 수록되었다. 또 제주특별자치도에서는 40개 지역의 마을신앙이 수록되었다. 한편, 각 보고서에는 2007년 마을신앙 현황조사와 비교할 수 있도록 전승 여부를 목록을 수록하였다.

The National Folk Museum of Korea is preparing a list of village beliefs transmission status table, or continuous status of village beliefs, while investigating village beliefs, and the survey report includes a list of village beliefs transmission status table in Gyeongsangbuk-do in Daegu Metropolitan City in 2024.
und: 한국의 마을신앙:대구광역시, 경상북도(Village Beliefs in Korea:Daegu Metropolitan City and Gyeongsangbuk-do)는 국립민속박물관에서 시행중인 권역별 마을신앙 조사 중 한 부분으로 2024년 조사한 경상권 마을신앙* 중 대구광역시와 경상북도의 기록이다. 국립민속박물관은 마을신앙을 조사하면서 마을신앙 전승현황표, 즉 마을신앙 지속 현황 목록을 작성하고 있는데, 이 조사보고서에는 부록으로 2024년 대구광역시 경상북도 마을신앙 전승현황표가 수록되어있다.

en:
Folk Religion of Villages in Korea (Volume1,2) is a survey of nearly 150 folk scholars nationwide on a national scale and unit of Korean village beliefs at the National Folk Museum of Korea in 2005 and 2006. In 2005, the range of time was limited to the Lunar New Year's Day, and village beliefs that took place nationwide at the same time were investigated. In 2006, literature was investigated based on previously published reports, papers, and other data collections, and the status of village beliefs in Korea was identified through a survey for the deficiencies.

The field survey of the first full moon of January 2005 and the current status of village beliefs in 2006 can encompass both the public and diachronic aspects of the current village community beliefs. The first nationwide village faith survey attempted by the National Folk Museum could be the starting point for another folk field survey. Based on these surveys, you will be able to take a step forward in drawing a folk map.

The survey report on village beliefs in Korea published this time consists of 139 village survey reports based on the temporal range of the 2005 Lunar New Year's Day and the spatial range of the whole country, and a current status table on whether village beliefs continue, focusing on regional literature data published up to 2006. Due to the vastness of the data, the status table was published on CD-ROM, not on the paper.
und:
한국의 마을신앙:상,하(Folk religion of villages in Korea:Volume1,2)는 국립민속박물관에서 2005년과 2006년에 걸쳐 한국의 마을신앙을 전국적인 규모와 단위로 150명 가까운 전국 민속학자들의 인적 네트워크를 구성하여 조사한 것이다. 2005년에는 시간의 범위를 정월 대보름으로 한정시켜서 같은 시간에 전국적으로 동시에 이루어지는 마을신앙을 조사하였다. 2006년에는 기존에 발간된 보고서, 논문, 기타자료집 등을 토대로 하여 문헌을 조사하고 부족한 부분은 설문조사를 통하여 한국의 마을신앙현황을 파악하였다.

2005년 정월 대보름 현장조사와 2006년 마을신앙 현황조사는 현재 전승되는 마을공동체신앙에 대하여 공시적인 측면과 통시적인 측면을 아우를 수 있게 되었다. 국립민속박물관에서 처음 시도한 전국적인 규모의 마을신앙 조사는 또다른 민속 분야 조사의 시발점이 될 수 있을 것이다. 이러한 조사들을 토대로 하여 민속지도를 그려나가는 데 한걸음 나아갈 수 있을 것이다.

이번에 발간된 한국의 마을신앙 조사보고서는 2005년도 정월 대보름이라는 시간적인 범위와 전국이라는 공간적인 범위를 바탕으로 하여 조사된 139개의 마을조사 보고서와 2006년도 당시까지 출판된 지역별 문헌자료를 중심으로 조사된 마을신앙의 지속여부에 대해 조사한 현황표로 이루어져 있다. 현황표의 경우는 자료의 방대함으로 인해 지면이 아닌 CD-ROM에 실었다.

en: Village Beliefs in Korea: Ulsan Metropolitan City, South Gyeongsang Province (Ulsan Metropolitan City & Gyeongsangnam-do) is part of a survey of village beliefs by region conducted by the National Folk Museum of Korea and is a record of Ulsan Metropolitan City and South Gyeongsang Province among the Gyeongsang village beliefs surveyed in 2024. The National Folk Museum of Korea is preparing a list of village beliefs transmission status table, or continuous status of village beliefs, while investigating village beliefs, and the survey report includes a list of village beliefs transmission status table in Ulsan Metropolitan City and Gyeongsangnam-do City in 2024 (= list of continuous status of village beliefs in Gyeongsangnam-do, Ulsan Metropolitan City) and a list of village beliefs transmission status table in Busan in 2024 (= list of continuous status of village beliefs in Busan Metropolitan City).

Village Faith in Korea: North Jeolla Province (Polk Religion of Villages in Korea - Jeollabuk-do)

Starting in 2022, the National Folk Museum of Korea has divided the whole country into six regions, including Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Gyeongsang, Jeolla, Chungcheong, Gangwon, and Jeju, and is conducting a survey on village beliefs by region. Due to various factors such as industrialization, urbanization, and migration, village beliefs are rapidly disappearing, and the scale is reduced and the form is changed briefly in local village communities, including large cities, but village beliefs are still being handed down. This is because there are still people who try to protect village beliefs. From this point of view, it was necessary to observe and record how village beliefs are maintained and how they are changing.

In 2023, a survey of village beliefs was conducted in the Jeolla and Jeju areas. As a result, a report on village beliefs (total of 3 volumes) in ⌈ Korea was published following the Chungcheong area in 2022. This report is composed of three volumes: Gwangju Metropolitan City and Jeollanam-do, Jeollabuk-do, and Jeju Special Self-Governing Province. In Gwangju Metropolitan City and Jeollanam-do, a total of 49 regions, including 7 Gwangju Metropolitan City and 42 Jeollanam-do, were included. And in Jeollabuk-do, 35 regions of village beliefs were included. In addition, 40 regions of Jeju Special Self-Governing Province included village beliefs. Meanwhile, each report included a list of whether or not it was transmitted for comparison with the 2007 survey on the current status of village beliefs.
und:
한국의 마을신앙:전라북도(Folk religion of villages in Korea - Jeollabuk-do)

2022년부터 국립민속박물관은 서울•경기•인천권, 경상권, 전라권, 충청권, 강원권, 제주권 등 전국을 여섯 개의 권역으로 나누고, 권역별 마을신앙 조사를 시행하고 있다. 산업화, 도시화, 이주 등의 다양한 요인으로 인해 마을신앙은 빠르게 사라지고, 대도시를 비롯한 지역의 마을 공동체에서는 그 규모는 축소되고, 형식은 간략하게 바뀌어 가지만, 여전히 마을신앙이 전해오고 있다. 이는 마을신앙을 지키기 위해 노력하는 사람들이 여전히 존재하고 있기 때문이다. 이러한 관점에서 마을신앙이 어떻게 유지되고 있는지, 어떻게 변화되고 있는지 등에 관해 관찰하고, 기록할 필요가 있었다.

2023년에는 전라권과 제주권을 대상으로 마을신앙 조사를 시행하였다. 그 결과 2022년 충청권에 이어 ⌈한국의 마을신앙(전라•제주권) 조사보고서 (총3권).⌋를 발간하게 되었다. 본 보고서는 광주광역시•전라남도 1권, 전라북도 1권, 제주특별자치도 1권으로 총 3권으로 구성되었다. 광주광역시•전라남도에서는 광주광역시 7곳, 전라남도 42곳 등 총 49개 지역이 수록되었다. 그리고 전라북도에서는 35개 지역의 마을신앙이 수록되었다. 또 제주특별자치도에서는 40개 지역의 마을신앙이 수록되었다. 한편, 각 보고서에는 2007년 마을신앙 현황조사와 비교할 수 있도록 전승 여부를 목록을 수록하였다.

en:
South Korea's Village Belief: South Chungcheong Province (Polk Religion of Villages in Korea - Chungcheongnam-do)

The National Folk Museum of Korea is responsible for conducting folk surveys that publicly and diachronically discover and identify the origins and transmission of folklore that make up our lives from traditional society to modern society, and at the same time, it is in charge of transmitting them. As one of these folk research projects, the whole country, including Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Gyeongsang, Jeolla, Chungcheong, Gangwon, and Jeju, is divided into six regions from 2022, and a village faith survey is conducted accordingly.

The first survey area in 2022 is the Chungcheon area. The investigation was urgent because the Chungcheon area underwent the biggest change in accordance with the national project of administrative-centered complex city construction.

The result of the 2022 survey on village beliefs by region is the ⌈ Korean Village Faith ⌋ (Chungcheong area) survey report (a total of three volumes). This survey report contains the contents of participatory observation and investigation of village beliefs in the Chungcheong region corresponding to Daejeon Metropolitan City, Sejong Special Self-Governing City, Chungcheongnam-do, and Chungcheongbuk-do conducted in January 2022.
und:
한국의 마을신앙:충청남도(Folk religion of villages in Korea - Chungcheongnam-do)

국립민속박물관은 전통사회에서 현대사회까지 우리의 삶을 이루고 있는 민속의 기원과 전승을 공시적•통시적으로 발굴하고 규명하는 민속조사를 실시하는 동시에 전승하는 역할을 담당하고 있다. 이러한 민속조사 사업의 하나로 2022년부터 서울•경기•인천권, 경상권, 전라권, 충청권, 강원권, 제주권 등 전국을 여섯 개의 권역으로 나누고, 그에 따른 권역별 마을신앙 조사를 실시하고 있다.

2022년 첫 번째 조사지역은 충천권역이다. 충천권역은 행정중심복합도시건설이라는 국가적 사업에 따라 가장 큰 변화를 겪었기 때문에 조사가 시급했다.

2022년 권역별 마을신앙 조사의 결과물은 ⌈한국의 마을신앙⌋(충청권) 조사보고서(총 3권)이다. 이 조사보고서에는 2022년 정월에 진행된 대전광역시, 세종특별자치시, 충청남도, 충청북도에 해당하는 충청권역의 마을신앙을 참여관찰하여 조사한 내용을 담고 있다.

en: The Korean Green Classification System Guidelines (K-Taxonomy Guidelines) are guidelines for the Korean green classification system established by the Ministry of Environment in accordance with the Environmental Technology and Environmental Industry Support Act revised on April 13, 2021. The Korean green classification system can be used for green finance as a guide to define green economic activities. For example, it can be applied to projects subject to investment in green bonds in connection with the 'Korean Green Bond Guidelines' of the Ministry of Environment and the Financial Services Commission published in December 2020 to support and revitalize investment in environmental responsibility. Institutions that issue green bonds will be able to increase the trust of investors by selecting projects that correspond to true green economic activities by utilizing the Korean green classification system.
und: 한국형 녹색분류체계 가이드라인(K-Taxonomy Guidelines)은 환경부에서 2021년 4월 13일 자로 개정된 「환경기술 및 환경산업 지원법」에 따라 수립한 한국형 녹색분류체계의 가이드라인이다. 한국형 녹색분류체계는 녹색경제활동을 정의하는 지침서로써 녹색금융에 활용될 수 있다. 그 예시로 환경책임투자 지원 및 활성화를 위해 2020년 12월 발간된 환경부와 금융위원회의 ‘한국형 녹색채권 가이드라인’과 연계하여 녹색채권의 투자 대상 프로젝트에 적용될 수 있다. 녹색채권을 발행하는 기관들은 한국형 녹색분류체계를 활용하여 진정한 녹색경제활동에 해당하는 프로젝트를 선정하여 투자자들의 신뢰를 증진할 수 있을것이다.

en:
The Korean Patent Classification (KPC) is its own patent classification system introduced in 2022 to solve the overcrowding phenomenon of prior literature in CPC classification sites and to improve the efficiency and accuracy of classification search.
Currently, advanced overseas patent offices are accelerating internationalization by establishing their own patent classification system (ex) Japan (JPO's FI, F-term) in addition to the existing IPC to support their own industries and reflect them in international patent classification.
Accordingly, in accordance with the necessity of establishing and internationalizing its own patent classification system, Korea began designing KPC codes in 2021 and introduced them in earnest in 2022.
In 2021, a total of 244 detailed KPC codes were newly established by conducting KPC code design for nine technical fields such as organic light emitting materials, quantum computers, and mRNA vaccines. In 2022, a total of 179 detailed KPC codes were newly established for 10 technical fields such as hydrogen energy, quantum cryptography, and welding jig, and in 23, 154 detailed KPC codes for 5 technical fields such as robot vacuum cleaners and surgical robots.
und:
KPC(Korean Patent Classification, 한국형 혁신특허분류체계)는 CPC 분류개소의 선행문헌 과밀화 현상 해소 및 분류검색의 효율성 및 정확성 제고 등을 목적으로 '22년부터 도입된 자체 특허분류체계입니다.
현재 해외 선진 특허청들은 기존의 IPC 이외에 고유의 자체 특허분류 체계(ex) 일본(JPO)의 FI, F-term)를 구축하여 자국의 산업을 지원하고 국제 특허분류에 반영하는 등 국제화에 박차를 가하고 있습니다.
이에 우리나라도 이와 같은 자체 특허분류체계의 구축 및 국제화 필요성에 따라 '21년부터 KPC 코드설계를 시작하여 '22년에 본격 도입하기에 이르렀습니다.
'21년에는 유기발광재료, 양자컴퓨터, mRNA 백신 등 9개 기술분야를 대상으로 KPC 코드설계를 수행하여 총 244개의 세부 KPC 코드를 신설하였으며, '22년은 수소에너지, 양자암호, 용접지그 등 10개 기술분야 대상 총 179개, '23년은 로봇청소기, 수술로봇 등 5개 기술분야 대상 총 154개의 세부 KPC 코드를 신설하였습니다.

en: The HARBOR Classification System is a system classified to manage and operate ports systematically and efficiently according to the Port Act and the Enforcement Decree, and ports are largely divided into trading ports and coastal ports.
und: 항만분류체계(HARBOR Classification System)는 항만법 및 시행령에 따라 항만을 체계적이고 효율적으로 관리·운영하기 위해 분류한 체계로, 항만은 크게 무역항과 연안항으로 구분됩니다.

en: The Classification of Nuclear Materials by Grade is the class of nuclear materials subject to physical protection. Considering the potential risk, it is classified into grade I, grade II, and grade III. The requirements for protection can be found in the Enforcement Decree of the Radioactive Disaster Prevention Act (attached Table 2), the protection requirements for nuclear facilities, etc. (related to Article 16).
ko: 핵물질의 등급별 분류(Classification of Nuclear Materials by Grade)은 물리적 방호의 대상이 되는 핵물질의 등급이다. 잠재적 위험도를 고려하여 등급Ⅰ, 등급Ⅱ 및 등급Ⅲ으로 분류한다. 방호의 요건은 방사능방재법 시행령 [별표2] 원자력시설등의 방호요건(제16조 관련)에서 확인 가능하다.

en: The specialist thesaurus contains a large number of German and English terms that are relevant for assessing the condition of archaeological cultural assets and describing conservation and restoration measures. This also includes the names of the materials and tools required, as well as descriptive terms for technological evaluations with regard to the manufacturing techniques and use of the objects.  This thesaurus is a comprehensive collection of terminology used in practice to describe the conservation and restoration processes carried out, as used in the ‘Restaurierung, Konservierung und Materialanalytik’ competence area at the Leibniz Centre for Archaeology (LEIZA).
und: Der Fachthesaurus umfasst eine Vielzahl von deutschen und englischen Begriffen, die für die Zustandserfassung und die Beschreibung von Konservierungs- und Restaurierungsmaßnahmen archäologischer Kulturgüter relevant sind. Dazu gehören auch die Bezeichnungen der benötigten Materialien und Werkzeuge sowie die beschreibenden Begriffe für technologische Auswertungen hinsichtlich der Herstellungstechnik und des Gebrauchs der Objekte.  Dieser Thesaurus ist eine umfassende Sammlung der in der Praxis verwendeten Terminologie zur Beschreibung der durchgeführten Konservierungs- und Restaurierungsprozesse, wie sie im Kompetenzbereich “Restaurierung, Konservierung und Materialanalytik” am Leibniz-Zentrum für Archäologie (LEIZA) verwendet wird.

"Mit dem Orientierungsrahmen hat das Land Nordrhein-Westfalen eine verbindliche Grundlage für die Lehreraus- und Lehrerfortbildung in der digitalisierten Welt geschaffen. Anknüpfend an die bekannten Handlungsfelder für Lehrerinnen und Lehrer – Unterrichten, Erziehen, Lernen und Leisten fördern, Beraten und Schule entwickeln – zeigt der Orientierungsrahmen auf, welche neuen – unter den Bedingungen der Digitalisierung künftig aber zentralen – Kompetenzen, es auszubilden gilt. Der Orientierungsrahmen macht transparent, welche pädagogischen und didaktischen Kompetenzen das Land bei Lehrkräften für grundlegend hält, den Herausforderungen und Chancen der Digitalisierung gestaltend zu begegnen. Für die Lehreraus- und Lehrerfortbildung sind damit zukunftsweisende Weichen gestellt worden."

en: The Mammalian Phenotype Ontology is being developed by Cynthia L. Smith, Susan M. Bello, Anna, Anagnostopoulos, Carroll W. Goldsmith and Janan T. Eppig, as part of the Mouse Genome Database (MGD) Project, Mouse Genome Informatics (MGI), The Jackson Laboratory, Bar Harbor, ME. This file contains pre-coordinated phenotype terms, definitions and synonyms that can be used to describe mammalian phenotypes. The ontology is represented as a directed acyclic graph (DAG). It organizes phenotype terms into major biological system headers such as nervous system and respiratory system. This ontology is currently under development. Weekly updates are available at the Mouse Genome Informatics (MGI) ftp site (ftp://ftp.informatics.jax.org/pub/reports/index.html#pheno) as well as the OBO Foundry site (http://obofoundry.org/). Japanese labels of MP were created by the MP Japanese Translation Project (https://github.com/dbcls/MP_Japanse). Questions, comments and suggestions are welcome, and should be directed to pheno@jax.org, Susan.Bello@jax.org or to GitHub tracker (https://github.com/mgijax/mammalian-phenotype-ontology/issues) MGD is funded by NIH/NHGRI grant HG000330.

"The Orphanet Rare Disease ontology (ORDO) is jointly developed by Orphanet and the EBI to provide a structured vocabulary for rare diseases capturing relationships between diseases, genes and other relevant features which will form a useful resource for the computational analysis of rare diseases. It derived from the Orphanet database (www.orpha.net ) , a multilingual database dedicated to rare diseases populated from literature and validated by international experts. It integrates a nosology (classification of rare diseases), relationships (gene-disease relations, epiemological data) and connections with other terminologies (MeSH, UMLS, MedDRA),databases (OMIM, UniProtKB, HGNC, ensembl, Reactome, IUPHAR, Geantlas) or classifications (ICD10)."

"The Mondo Disease Ontology (Mondo) aims to harmonize disease definitions across the world. It is a semi-automatically constructed ontology that merges in multiple disease resources to yield a coherent merged ontology."

KAKEN Category Schema

KAKEN category definitions are based on a program from Japan called the Kakenhi Program (Grants-in-Aid for Scientific Research). Kakenhi provides competitive funds for the development of scientific research, from basic to applied research in all fields ranging across the humanities, the social sciences, and the natural sciences. These grants provide financial support for creative and pioneering research projects that will become the foundation of social development. Projects are selected using a peer-review screening process.

The Chemical Analysis Ontology (CAO) is organized using the BFO framework with entries primarily under concepts (not complete by any means), material entities, information content entities (data items), roles, and processes. Currently, the ontology is more of a vocabulary in that development of predicates (ontology properties) that relate subjects to objects has not been a focal point.

The Chemical Information Ontology (CHEMINF) aims to establish a standard in representing chemical information. In particular, it aims to produce an ontology to represent chemical structure and to richly describe chemical properties, whether intrinsic or computed.

CHMO, the chemical methods ontology, describes methods used to collect data in chemical experiments, such as mass spectrometry and electron microscopy prepare and separate material for further analysis, such as sample ionisation, chromatography, and electrophoresis synthesise materials, such as epitaxy and continuous vapour deposition It also describes the instruments used in these experiments, such as mass spectrometers and chromatography columns. It is intended to be complementary to the Ontology for Biomedical Investigations (OBI).
A crystallography domain ontology based on EMMO and the CIF core dictionary. It is implemented as a formal language.

EMMO results from a multidisciplinary effort to develop a standard representational framework that is consistent with scientific principles and methodologies. It is based on physics, analytical philosophy and information and communication technologies. EMMO provides a framework for knowledge capture and interoperability in applied science and engineering, especially materials science and manufacturing. It is released under a Creative Commons CC BY 4.0 license.

The primary purpose of ISO 15926 is to provide a foundation ontology to support the integration and sharing of data related to the lifecycle of a process plant in such a way that it is consistent, unambiguous, and minimizing the number of ways something could be expressed. Further purpose of ISO 15926-14 is to meet needs for OWL 2 ontologies that are based on ISO 15926-2, that enable efficient reasoning and that capture lifecycle information. A specific purpose is to demonstrate lifecycle modelling through a representation of the lifecycle model of ISO/IEC 81346-1. Another specific purpose is to exemplify how this standard can be used to develop industrial ontologies through various real-world use cases from industy.

OntoCAPE is a large-scale ontology for the domain of Computer Aided Process Engineering (CAPE). Represented in a formal, machine-interpretable ontology language, OntoCAPE captures consensual knowledge of the process engineering domain in a generic way such that it can be reused and shared by groups of people and across software systems. On the basis of OntoCAPE, novel software support for various engineering activities can be developed; possible applications include the systematic management and retrieval of simulation models and design documents, electronic procurement of plant equipment, mathematical modeling, as well as the integration of design data from distributed sources.

prefLabel.en: Ontology for computer aided process engineering

en: The purpose of this article is to present an ontology, termed OntoCompChem, for quantum chemistry calculations as performed by the Gaussian quantum chemistry software, as well as a semantic web service named MolHub. The OntoCompChem ontology has been developed based on the semantics of concepts specified in the CompChem convention of Chemical Markup Language (CML) and by extending the Gainesville Core (GNVC) ontology. MolHub is developed in order to establish semantic interoperability between different tools used in quantum chemistry and thermochemistry calculations, and as such is integrated into the J-Park Simulator (JPS) - a multi-domain interactive simulation platform and expert system. It uses the OntoCompChem ontology and implements a formal language based on propositional logic as a part of its query engine, which verifies satisfiability through reasoning. This paper also presents a NASA polynomial use-case scenario to demonstrate semantic interoperability between Gaussian and a tool for thermodynamic data calculations within MolHub.

An ontology for capturing both data and the semantics of chemical kinetic reaction mechanisms has been developed. Such mechanisms can be applied to simulate and understand the behavior of chemical processes, for example, the emission of pollutants from internal combustion engines. An ontology development methodology was used to produce the semantic model of the mechanisms, and a tool was developed to automate the assertion process. As part of the development methodology, the ontology is formally represented using a web ontology language (OWL), assessed by domain experts, and validated by applying a reasoning tool. The resulting ontology, termed OntoKin, has been used to represent example mechanisms from the literature. OntoKin and its instantiations are integrated to create a knowledge base (KB), which is deployed using the RDF4J triple store. The use of the OntoKin ontology and the KB is demonstrated for three use cases—querying across mechanisms, modeling atmospheric pollution dispersion, and as a mechanism browser tool. As part of the query use case, the OntoKin tools have been applied by a chemist to identify variations in the rate of a prompt NOx formation reaction in the combustion of ammonia as represented by four mechanisms in the literature. Merged with OntoCAPE.

und: Taxonomy of Key Service Types or Categorizations

en: "The following represents a linear or flat representation of the different Service Types or Categories that are used by Information Technology (IT) organizations, professionals and their business clients to help define, deploy and manage the many different Services that are used to facilitate Work Management or Service Management solutions."

OSMO is an ontologization and extension of MODA, a workflow metadata standard that constitutes a mandatory requirement within a number of European calls and projects in the context of materials modelling. OSMO was developed within the Horizon 2020 project VIMMP (Virtual Materials Marketplace) and is part of a larger effort in ontology engineering driven by the European Materials Modelling Council, with the European Materials and Modelling Ontology (EMMO) as its core.

prefLabel.en: Ontology for simulation, modelling, and optimization

en: An ontology of physico-chemical processes, i.e. physico-chemical changes occurring in course of time. This ontology is not well structured and lacks of properties. Also the design principle is not clear. Nevertheless it provides a good amount of concepts important to macroscopic and microscopic physical processes in form of a more hierarchical structure.

RXNO is the name reaction ontology. It contains more than 500 classes representing organic name reactions such as the Diels–Alder cyclization and the Cannizzaro reaction to their roles in an organic synthesis.

The Systems Biology Ontology is a set of controlled, relational vocabularies of terms commonly used in Systems Biology, and in particular in computational modelling. It consists of seven orthogonal vocabularies defining: reaction participants roles (e.g. „substrate“), quantitative parameters (e.g. „Michaelis constant“), classification of mathematical expressions describing the system (e.g. „mass action rate law“), modelling framework used (e.g. „logical framework“), the nature of the entity (e.g. „macromolecule“), the type of interaction (e.g. „process“), as well as a branch to define the different types of metadata that may be present within a model.
A list of software categories used in KOS software.

Archival Resource Keys (ARKs) serve as persistent identifiers, or stable, trusted references for information objects. Among other things, they aim to be web addresses (URLs) that don’t return 404 Page Not Found errors. The ARK Alliance is an open global community supporting the ARK infrastructure on behalf of research and scholarship.
A DOI is a digital identifier of an object, any object — physical, digital, or abstract. DOIs solve a common problem: keeping track of things. Things can be matter, material, content, or activities.

The ePIC (Persistent Identifier Consortium for eResearch) PID is a globally unique, persistent identifier designed for long-term management and referencing of digital and physical resources. Developed by the ePIC consortium, it ensures that data, samples, publications, or other research outputs remain accessible and citable over time. The system supports robust metadata and flexible resolution services, making it a versatile tool for managing research assets in a reliable and interoperable manner.

FactGrid is a specialized Wikibase platform tailored for academic research, leveraging software initially developed for Wikimedia’s Wikidata project. It enables researchers to manage and interlink data with flexibility beyond traditional relational databases. Users can define and customize objects (“items”) and their properties, facilitating diverse and complex data structures.

An IGSN ID is a globally unique and persistent identifier for material samples. The core purpose of the IGSN ID is to enable transparent and traceable connections between research activities and objects, including samples, collections, instruments, grants, data, publications, people, and organizations.

en:
"The following represents a linear or flat taxonomy of the many different key Taxonomy types or categorizations that are used by Information Technology (IT) organizations and professionals to help define, structure, organize, and understand various forms of Data, Information, and Knowledge. Such a Taxonomy is often used as a foundation for activities like data modeling (i.e. the design, definition and development of other Taxonomies and Ontologies). Such constructs are also often used as mechanisms to provide clarity and standardize terminology for communications between business stakeholders and IT organizations.

Note: Each of these Taxonomy types or categorizations is directly aligned with the specific form of Taxonomy Management."

"NASA PDS4 Information Model Classes"

Ontology of Astronomical Object Types
"Astronomical object types and properties used in SIMBAD. Created during the European VOTech project."
IHDEA TREPS-FRAMES
A collection of reference frames used by the CDPP/TREPS tool.

The IVOA VOEvent Roles Ontology provides a controlled vocabulary to classify astronomical events within the VOEvent standard. It defines roles like observation, prediction, test, and utility to specify the nature and context of events. This enables consistent interpretation and automated processing across the Virtual Observatory.

und: Taxonomy of Key Unique Identifier Types or Categorizations
